# Next-action custody follow-up — w-jc2

Read reports/w-jc2-review.md for the six independent findings. The fever/, gym/
and spread/ subpackets preserve independent provenance investigations and their
raw acquisition/audit output. None is a run receipt or closure authorization.

bind_inputs.py extracts only the current standard-library gold projection
helpers for Physics Questions, Sports Understanding and StrategyQA, without
importing their adapters or invoking scorers. It binds every ordered installed
row to the exact JSON gold serialization SHA-256 used by qa/base.py's verifier
specification. Gold values are not exported. Each gold-bindings.json retains
null selection/run/side/trial fields: this complete inventory does not choose
tasks, authenticate eligibility or become a selected manifest. Source and CSV
hashes have separate raw sha256sum output. Current source hashes also authenticate
the existing hash-and-parse-one-buffer checker, not any actual runtime execution.

registry-before.json is the exact starting HEAD registry. check_scope.py requires
all changes to stay within the six observed fields and this deliverable scope;
statuses, next_actions, evidence arrays, history and both shared records must
remain byte-equivalent as parsed JSON. The registry checker independently checks
all existing verbatim evidence locators. No production or gate source is edited.

Read-only reproduction (installed external data must still be present):

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/bind_inputs.py --check
python3 tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/replay_prior_inventory.py
python3 tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/check_scope.py
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/SHA256SUMS
python3 tools/check_dataset_blockers.py
```

The parent validation report preserves argv, stdout, stderr and exit status.
Its packet checksum list excludes itself, Python caches and no other evidence.
No upstream source bytes, frozen receipt, run ID, dataset pool or model server
is modified. No model endpoint or paid API is contacted. Public provenance
downloads and host-only custody computations are the only acquisitions here.
